title: Buffer View
description: A span of bytes in a buffer.

byteLength.title: Byte Length
byteLength.description: The length of the buffer view in bytes.

byteOffset.title: Byte Offset
byteOffset.description: The offset into the buffer in bytes.

byteStride.title: Byte Stride
byteStride.description: The stride, in bytes, between consecutive vertex attribute values.

target.title: Usage Target
target.description: The optional hint specifying that the buffer view is directly used for vertex attributes or indices.

anyOf.title: Vertex Array
anyOf.description: The buffer view is used for vertex attributes.

anyOf.title: Element Array
anyOf.description: The buffer view is used for vertex indices.
